outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental workflow, not a data plot.
Panel B shows representative fluorescence, H&E, and bright-field micrograph/photograph images, not a plot of averaged data.
Bar chart of lactate concentration across Normal lung, LUAD, and LUSC groups shows individual data points overlaid as dots on top of the mean bars with error bars.
Bar chart of lactate concentration in high pH vs low pH regions shows individual data points overlaid as dots on top of the mean bars with error bars.
Panel E is a schematic model illustrating the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment, not a data plot.
